name: Apache Hadoop
description: Download and verify the official Apache Hadoop binary distribution. Hadoop does not publish a standard official APT repository in its installation documentation.

installer.artifact_source: Apache official release mirrors linked from https://hadoop.apache.org/releases.html
installer.configuration_policy: Do not configure HDFS/YARN or start daemons automatically; present the official single-node setup guide after extraction.

post_install_notes: Hadoop is a framework distribution, not a simple APT repository package.
The release page must be consulted at runtime; never assume the hard-coded observed version remains latest.
Verify the downloaded archive signature or checksum before extraction.
